Conversation.line: One time, I had to... 'put down' one of my own crewmates.
Wait, I'm not done with the story!
Go ahead, then...
The poor fucker was injured in a crawler swarm attack, his fucking leg got ripped off.
The crew's doc didn't make it in time, but the instant I turned to go to the armoury he became a FUCKING HUSK!
I panic fired an entire clip into it, and when it went down we just sort of chucked it in a ballast room.
The thing is, uh, that while I was minding my own business, one of the assistants just started screaming. Hold on *Ahem*
“ARGGHHGH! IT'S BACK!? WHAT THE FUCK! SECURITY! IT GOT BACK UP! IT GOT BACK UP!”
So I had to go back there and shoot it again, because, well, it had climbed out on its own. And it was alive!
However! This time I made sure to shoot it in the head as well. To REALLY make sure it was dead.
Also, don't ever chuck husks inside of ballasts. Just flush them out the airlock... or just burn them.
Anyone ever wonder what husks look like underneath the rusted diving suit?
You don't know?
I mean, how would you even know? You can't take the suit off of them, they say it's like it's glued to them.
I did see a recent husk once, though, one without a diving suit. They look human for the most part, 'cept for the stinger jaw. 'Y know?
I've seen some of those as well, but not- uh, “recent”.
What? I thought the only husks that survived in the long run were those with diving suits.
That's true, but you can still see some fairly old ones inside certain wrecks that don't even have suits.
Watch out though, they may look weak, but they are tough to put down.
So what do they look like?
You are better off without knowing.
From what I've seen, they are the closest thing to a living skeleton I'll tell you that much.
They are best described as 'Iron deficiency Man with a hint of starvation'.
What's an 'Iron defeciency man'?
Someone clearly didn't read up on their Earth comic history
Yeah you'll probably need to get that done.
It doesn't take too long too.
One time, I saw a spider with human arms.
Did I stutter?
No, but...
It's true! End of the story.
Just kidding. I made it up.
Hahahaha! Thank goodness it was a joke.
Or was it?
You know...
Ok, listen, how the fuck am I supposed to know? Do you seriously think I could know what you're about to say?
It's just an idiom!
NO it isn't!
Ok! Ok! It's just a filler word!
WHY DID YOU START A SENTENCE WITH A FILLER WORD?!
Argh! It's just, like, a word, ok? I was about to fucken' say something very interesting, but now I don't want to anymore!
Next time just SAY the thing you want to say! You're all like “I- I- You- Wow I- Like-”
WHAT?! WHAT IS IT? No, I DO NOT KNOW. I DON'T KNOW WHAT YOU'RE GONNA SAY.
BECAUSE YOU HAVEN'T SAID IT YET!
JUST SPIT IT THE FUCK OUT! ARGHH!
It's that time of the month, eh?
Ha ha ha!
What's funny?
YOU FUCKING BITCH!
FUUUUCKING FUCKEAHH
Damn, man...
What's wrong?
I was in an outpost sometime ago, you know, just doing business as usual...
But then, the guy I was talking to just DROPPED to the ground and started having a seizure! And then a bunch of tentacles came out of his face!
I don't know what that was all about, all I know is that a bunch of security guys came in and dealt with... that.
Sounds like a husk infection to me... That's... Terrifyingly common these days.
Well, at least it didn't happen to you!
Wait, was it stingers coming from the mouth or actual fucking tentacles... wait don't answer that.
That sounds fantastic! I bet the ladies love that guy!
Did anyone ever figure out what the deal is with husk infection?
I don't think anyone would ever touch that shit with a ten feet pole, honestly.
Someone has to, you know? Someone HAS to be trying to find a way to get rid of it-
I mean, they tried but the fucking cultist bitches screwed us over, and have you seen the... THINGS...
For example, I've been hearing about a, like... imagine a Husk, but it's alteast 7ft tall, blackened-rotten but still seemingly alive muscle, no skin, and like... HAS FUCKING ARMBLADES!
Which one, man?
Uhh... What? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHICH ONE?!
I've heard of two kinds, one with the regular old diving suit get up... The other, well...
WELL I DIDN'T KNOW THERE WAS FUCKING TWO!? Wait... what makes the second so special... DON'T TELL ME IT CAN SPIT ACID?!
Does that even matter? You have to shoot 'em either way. It's you or them.
I... this will H A U N T me until the day the Europan seas claim me.
I've heard that there are atleast seven different kinds, one with the regular old diving suit get up... The others, well...
SEVEN!? THERE ARE 7 OF THOSE FREAK?! Wait... DON'T TELL ME ONE OF THEM CAN SPIT ACID?!
Oh so you know of the one in the Abyss diving suit?
Ah, you know of the kind that wears the Abyss diving suit? All you need to do is avoid shooting their head, for obvious reasons.
I... this will H A U N T me until the day the Europan seas claim me.
And if you think that's bad?
There's a varient that still wears an old rusted exosuit.
OH GOD NO!?
Don't worry, while it is pretty tanky, it's held back by the lack of space it had for its mutation, so if it gets inside the ship so it can only get stuck in a room.
Thank... god...?
You can almost feel bad for them...
For example, people have been talking about a 'husked watcher', but that's just the half of it.
Now, that THING will literally SCREAM when provoked! Completely unlike a husked crawler or human.
And you want to know what has been reported COUNTLESS TIMES after it does that?!
The little troop of husked monsters that it usually has around itself? It starts falling behind, until it's like they're gone.
Next thing you know, there's a bunch of nightmares creatures fucking clawing at your ship, or spitting at it, or worse! Pretty suspicious, ain't it?
Dude, you know that watchers can't be husked, right? They're too big for that to even happen!
I fucking hope so or I will have nightmares that no medicine will fix.
For example, people have been claiming that they have seen 'Mutant Husks', this has been going around from Outpost to Outpost and the details are always grisly
Could one possibly think that they are all made up? Especially when considering multiple people have reported the same things?
Some people have reported seeing groups of strange humanoid monsters that, like most things, get terribly dismembered when shot...
Now here's the thing... These monsters supposedly KEEP ON GOIN' after they get dismembered!
Alright, I AIN'T touching that with a hundred feet pole!
Are you sure they weren't just regular ol' husks?
I have no idea! I honestly hope I don't get to see them. Like ever.
I've heard stories about an odd Endworm head that prefers to stalk outside of the abyss.
Oh god... so we are not safe even if we avoid the abyss?
A few have been nicknaming it 'the leviathan'. Mainly due to it's relation to a creature from an old Earth game
These things can tear through hulls with ease. Other times they just attempt to ram the submarines into the sides of the caves.
Now that's... another thing to keep me up at night.
I also heard that they are quite easily dealt with, actually it's weaker than your average rogue endworm head.
Oh thank god...
It's been nicknamed 'the leviathan'
Heard that thing can tear through submarines with ease. Other times they just attempt to ram the submarines into the sides of the caves.
Now that's... another thing to keep me up at night.
I also heard that they are quite easily dealt with, actually it's weaker than your average rogue endworm head.
Oh thank god...
For example, the several reports of husked monsters being found in the abyss!
How could that possibly make any sense?
What do you mean?
What do you think lives in the abyss?
I'll tell you: endworms and charybdises!
I'll tell you: endworms and charybdises! Hell I've been told even Latchers get infected, though it is hard to tell with how similar they act to their uninfected brethren.
Do you really think those monsters could ever succumb to some weak parasite that until a few months ago was only affecting humans and crawlers?
Well... It's not like the abyss would be a safe place without husks anyway, so does that really matter at all??
As long as whatever is down there STAYS there, I guess so.
I've been told that there are even mutated abyss creatures, though I've only ever seen reports of endworms getting mutated.
WHAT!? WHAT DO YOU MEAN MUTATED ENDWORMS!?!?
Well I hope we never come across any mutated abyss creature, PERIOD.
I saw a crawler the other day...
Dear God...
But wait, there's more!
This crawler, or whatever the hell it was, it looked bigger and meaner and...
Oh, I know what you're talking about. Certain crawlers can grow to pretty large sizes, so you probably just saw a big one.
It wasn't a crawler! IT looked like one, but it was just... UGH! How do I say this?
I might have an idea of what it was. Did it have stingers coming out of its face?
Yeah, if I recall correctly...
Bingo! What you saw was just a husked crawler, then. There's plenty of them in this damned place.
No, it couldn't possibly have been a husked crawler... This thing looked ALIVE, I tell you! Not like a husk!
You know what, in life...
Don't cover the judge by... uh...
Don't judge the, the... cover! Judge the book!
Don't- Don't book the cover, book, eh!

Convesation.line: Don't- Whatever! Don't do it! Just don't do it!

But steel is heavier than feathers.

You said that they are both a kilogram, so they are LITERALLY the same weight!
